text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
(Now then... that's the orders for supplies and equipment
wrapped up for now. Since we're dealing with food, after all...
we have to be fully prepared—)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Phewww...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Chairwoman... Why not take a little rest?
You're handling your regular duties on top of everything,
so I worry you might be overworking yourself...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Hrmm...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...No! Even at this very moment, there are those working hard out there!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All right, is everyone watching?
When you want to water vegetables covered by mulch, you pour it right into the hole like this—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, don't worry, Spe-san.
I'm totally used to farm work now!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Everyone has become so dependable after gaining experience.
Alright, time for me to get to work too—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ……Hm? Whoa-whoa-whoa……

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Oh dear, this won't do.
I cannot set such a poor example as Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Isn't the Chairwoman
wobbling on her feet, though!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, hold on a second!?
Isn't this really bad!?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no, no need to worry!
I just got a little lightheaded, that's all—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
No way, of course I'm gonna worry!
If we don't pay attention and things get out of hand, it'll be too late!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right, everyone!
Let's carry the Chairwoman to the shade!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Heave-hooooooo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Uwoooh!?!?
Al-Altitude! Floating! A portable shrine!!
And—chanting "heave-ho!" together, everyone carried Chairwoman Akikawa under the shade of a tree.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Goodness me, ASTONISHING!
To think you could carry it off with such ease!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry... We all just couldn't help but worry about the Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Nay, nay, rest assured!
Possessing such power is absolute proof of proper nutrition!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Thanks to you, there's no need to worry.
............

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...W-What happened?
Are you really not feeling well...!?"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Hey.
Are you... happy right now?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Are you running well, studying well, eating well...
and living a happy academy life?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Are you chasing your own dream—
while keeping both body and mind healthy?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Of course!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes things are hard, but...
Rice loves running. I'm sure...
that will never, ever change!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...I see. That's what matters most.
......

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Throughout my time here, I haveâwatched many
students leave this academy."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! The world of competition is fierce.
It pains me to see losers, but that too
is the reality of being an athlete.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However... illness. Injury.
I have also seen countless students suddenly
have their paths cut short mid-dream...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...No matter how many times I experience it,
I simply cannot get used to it.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Throughout your time at the academy, I hope you never forget the pure joy of running.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
For that reason, the one effort I kept up as a bare minimum
was regarding my diet.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Maintaining a strong, healthy body—
No, that's not all."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to provide the students with meals
that would give them the energy
to keep running toward their dreams, time and time again.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Madam Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The Great Harvest Festival also stems from that sentiment.
If food can contribute even a little to your dreams, I will spare no effort.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...I want you all to keep having fun running forever.
That might just be my own ego talking, though..."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...It was also my one and only dream.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
“...... Ah, my bad!
I ended up talking for too long.”

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I shall quietly return
to my desk work for today. Farewell!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So the Chairwoman
said something like that, did she?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, Rice was thinking.
Giving it my all for the event will be the same as always, but—"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"For the Chairwoman's sake... I was wondering
if there's something we could all do to give back."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah! We're repaying the Chairwoman for her kindness, right!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I completely agree! We definitely have to
repay the debt of food, after all!

All the students gathered there began to voice their
agreement. Like ripples spreading across water,
the sound gradually grew louder and louder.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“Still... what would be the best way
to repay the favor?”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Then we'll just have to put our heads together!
To give back in the best way possible!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Well, for now... keep this a secret from the Chairwoman! Surprises are way better, right?

How to repay Chairwoman Akikawa—
For the time being, we wrapped things up
and disbanded for the day.
